name: Pinytus
bio: Pinytus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 1st century AD. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of the Wreath of Philippus, the Garland compiled in the first century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 16).

poems.title: Book VII, 16: On the Same
poems.author: Pinytus
poems.text: The tomb holds the bones and the dumb name of Sappho, but her skilled words are immortal.
